name: billowing_shriekmass_threshold_at_seven_cards
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, mill three cards. Threshold — This creature gets +2/+1 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.' Seat 0's graveyard holds four cards. Billowing Shriekmass (2/3) enters and mills three: seven cards, so it is 4/4. The opponent's graveyard is not read.
